source.architecture: exact frozen A1 64D selected-epoch R4 and EZ-oriented margin
source.selected_epoch_threshold: reuse exact A1 per-cell VLOO-selected epoch and threshold without new target outcome selection
source.contexts: distinct (fold,selected_epoch,selected_threshold) pairs; relational readout trained in that exact A1 coordinate system
source.source_reproduction: prior 150-checkpoint and exact R4 replay; matched B0 AP must equal 0.5767434626151353 within 1e-6

fit_selection.split: deterministic 80/20 patient-ID split within each fold FIT population, shared across all contexts and methods
fit_selection.criterion: mean patient-equal EZ-AP across distinct selected A1 contexts within each fold
fit_selection.lambda_selection: one lambda per fold and architecture using FIT only; separately retain BCE-only and best positive-lambda arms
fit_selection.r3_gate: run R3 only if R2 best FIT AP exceeds R1 best FIT AP by at least 0.01 on average and in at least 4 of 5 folds
fit_selection.r3_architecture: single learned scalar attention over pairwise relation embeddings, no Transformer

readout.R1: DeepSets 64-32-32 GELU phi, 97-32-1 GELU residual head
readout.R2: all-pairs 193-64-32 GELU relation encoder, mean other-channel relations, 97-32-1 GELU residual head
readout.R3: R2 plus 32-16-1 attention logit and softmax over other-channel references
readout.residual_output_initialization: exact zero weight and bias; epoch0 exact A1 margin
readout.R4_normalization: FIT-only per-dimension StandardScaler, separately for each A1 fold/epoch context; no target-derived statistics

training.selection: best FIT meta-validation patient-equal EZ-AP, epoch0 eligible
training.classification: exact A1 patient-equal weighted BCE: EZ weight 2, NEZ weight 1
training.ranking: mean softplus(NEZ margin minus EZ margin) over all within-patient EZ/NEZ pairs
training.full_fit_training_epochs: FIT-selected best epoch per context/lambda, no target early stopping

context_controls.full: all unlabeled channels of the target patient, including candidate and query channels; transductive B=0
context_controls.wrong_patient: deterministic nearest-size FIT patient from same A1 context, without any donor labels
context_controls.shuffled_relation: deterministic permutation of reference R4-to-A1-margin pairing; anchor R4/margin unchanged
context_controls.correct_wrong_and_shuffle: all scores and deterministic control choices frozen before new target label-using evaluation

diagnostics.A1_failure_strata: terciles of frozen A1 fixed-query patient AP, defined before any relational-outcome subgroup analysis
diagnostics.bootstrap: 10000 paired unique-patient-ID cluster resamples, seed 42; 20 repetitions and all folds retained per sampled ID
diagnostics.gates: exact thresholds and conditions in attached user prompt

stage2.eligibility: only if frozen R1/R2/R3 meets PROMISING or REACHES_B8 phase-1 gate
stage2.model: FIT-selected best relational architecture; end-to-end A1 initialized from exact source with residual head near zero
stage2.selection: FIT-only patient meta-validation; no target-result changes
stage2.not_eligible: do not unfreeze backbone or produce end-to-end outcome

caveat: exact A1 VLOO uses other target patients' labels for a scored patient's epoch/threshold selection; strict_target_label_sequencing=false; legacy monolithic loader materializes all 80 labels; strict_no_outer_label_materialization=false, while no outer predictions, metrics, or selection are computed
